author: evacfk
description: A multiplayer blackjack table with a shared shoe, seated players, card counting support, and button-based hit/stand/double play. Commands live under .wonderjack / .wonderjackset.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no end-user data beyond what Red's core economy/bank system already stores (bet amounts pass through the bank API and are not separately retained by this cog).
install_msg: Blackjack table loaded. Commands are under `.wonderjack` (not `.blackjack`, to avoid colliding with the Casino cog's blackjack game). Run `.wonderjackset settings` to see current config.
